title: Turned catalog feed migration into a self-service procedure used for 29 providers
summary: I built a consistent XML-to-JSON parser, wrote the migration procedure with the support team and took myself out of the approval path; 29 feed providers moved onto it without a developer involved.
what_would_have_happened: Inconsistent parser output kept blocking search indexing, and every feed migration waited on a developer.
the_call: Fix the parser once, then give the support engineers a procedure they could run without me as approver.
what_i_did: Designed and coded the parser and a bulk migrator, walked the support team through the procedure, and built their feedback into the guide.
what_changed: 29 providers migrated without developer involvement, and support engineers reported shorter, more readable transformation code.

metrics.label: less transformation code
metrics.context: about 600 to about 550 lines for one standard, per a support engineer

quotes.text: TL;DR The new parser implementation rocks and code is more readable and easy to understand !!
The wiki contains most of the steps on clear cut to complete the migration of a standard from old XML to NEW parser and that helped eliminating the Dev hand hold on migration.
